notes.title: New spells, more tiles customization
notes.content: [p]Version 0.9.9.1 brings following features:[/p][p]- New spell: Silence Field - disables all enemy spell-casting in a radius[/p][p]- New spell: Venom Surge - infects an enemy with poison that explodes on death, spreading toxins to nearby foes[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/f859086b0b039a96484ec9545538dd71807ab05b.png"][/img][/p][p]- Tiles customization! Do not like factory tiles? No problem replace them by your beloved ones. This time added: Interactive tiles[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/a31b22ccbd6a4dc423dd2e219f3b62681505e5d0.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Tiles customization
notes.content:
[p]Version 0.9.8.3 brings following features:[/p][p]- Tiles customization! Do not like factory tiles? No problem replace them by your beloved ones.[/p][p]  So far you can replace enemies, but more to come soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/0c1ba3bfc0bce31946ff21c514961e6216a7583c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]- New wall decoration inside dungeon : god statue.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/34c363f6cb5ad104aef557e53c2fc5fdb71b36ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]- Legendary Purifier sword now must be merged by a crafting recipe out of three pieces. 

- Some fixes (e.g. mini rats and spiders are back!)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ally enhanced, worm leaving a poisonous trail
notes.content: [p]Version 0.9.7.2 brings some exciting features:[/p][list][*][p]Skeleton ally can now use a projectile like weapons: Staffs, Bows (remember to also add arrows!)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy skeletons also use bows![/p][/*][*][p]New Scroll/Book: Rejuvenating Bloom - grows a magical plant that heals hero and allies over time[/p][/*][*][p]Worms are now leaving a poisonous trail[/p][/*][*][p]To use a stairs you have to now press a button (Default: >, <, Enter)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/5c96e885e2949b021774ffded48a09a53ef67742.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/5060e3d241d0ce55a3ca66af3cbb872566f5dddf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/3f7882066397020460bae21c578a55423592209c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Controller support!
notes.content:
Version 0.9.5.12 features:

- Controller support!!!, it was quite a task as game was intentionally optimized to be played by mouse+keyboard. After two months of hard work playing with gamepad is now a comparable experience to mouse+keyboard. 
- Playing using only a keyboard is also possible.
- Options->Keys redesigned - a dedicated dialog is shown when assigning a key
- New scroll/book: Weaken - reduce enemy statistics: Strength, Defense, Dexterity, Magic, Health
- some small fixes

notes.title: New spell, quick equipment comparer, and more
notes.content:
Features:
- Currently equipped item can now be shown for easy comparison using a dedicated key
- New scroll/book: Gravity Crush - slams enemies into the ground, dealing damage and (possibly) stunning them
- Player can change the book assigned to Mage class at the game start
- Events log dialog showing all events that happened during game's session added
- Achievements related to abilities were now working fine

notes.title: New books and scrolls
notes.content:
Version 0.9.2.0

- some enemies resist now fixed at certain (high) value not depending on enemy's level
- poison effect and bleeding effect now last longer
- Dexterity stat contributes to Chance To Melee Hit
- Mage class gets a book at the game start

- Two of spells proposed by user [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/ZZZZZZZZZZZZZBBBBBAAAACCCCCCCC]siren[/url] 
Offensive Spell: Blood Bolt - Costs HP instead of mana but deals massive damage to enemies.
Healing and Restoration Spell: Mana Conversion – Converts excess mana into health.
